data.footage_size: Building spans 4,282 square feet (two stories); not yet apparent if Good Neighbor will occupy the full space or a portion
data.short_description: Baltimore retail and café shop Good Neighbor plans its first DC location at 429 8th Street SE. No opening timeline is available yet. It sells coffee, tea and pastries alongside furniture, tableware and bath and body products.

data.location: 209 E. Orangefair Mall, Unit 11, Fullerton, CA 92832
data.short_description: BAQBA Mexican Grill is preparing to open in Fullerton, and a plan review has been filed with the Orange County Health Department. The fast-casual chain currently operates a location in Rialto. It serves customizable burritos, bowls, tacos and quesadillas.

Loud'n Roasted is opening a café in the Woodland Park Crossing shopping center in the former Meanwhile Coffee space. The location is in its early phases, and no opening timeline has been set. It will be the brand's third location, after Chantilly and Ashburn.
Meanwhile Coffee previously occupied the 2309 Woodland Crossing Drive space until it closed in August. Loud'n Roasted will take over the storefront.

Souplantation may reopen in The Shoppes at Costco Plaza, and a plan review has been filed with the Orange County health department. No exact opening date has been announced. It would be the revived brand's third restaurant and its first in California since the 2020 closures.

data.location: Five Points, Athens (full address not specified)
data.status: appears it will be opening in 2027
data.short_description: The team behind Puma Yu's will open the cocktail bar Hin in Five Points in Athens. Menu and design details remain unclear.
Cafe Hin will open as a "daytime companion" to Hin bar, according to the brand's Instagram. What Now confirmed the concept but could not get further details.

data.location: 505 Rue Principale, Québec, QC G2G 0J4 (YQB terminal, after security near gates 29 and 30)
data.short_description: Blaxton's bar and restaurant concept Lobbie is preparing to open inside Québec City Jean Lesage International Airport. It will offer fast-casual service, wine and shared plates, with seating for up to 75 guests. The airport website currently lists Lobbie as closed.

data.location: 505 Rue Principale, Québec, QC G2G 0J4 (YQB terminal)
data.short_description: The airport announced an Air Canada Café alongside Lobbie and a new lounge. The café opened in June 2026, according to Air Canada.

data.location: 505 Rue Principale, Québec, QC G2G 0J4 (YQB terminal, behind Lobbie)
data.short_description: The airport website lists the new paid Boréal Lounge, located behind Lobbie, as opening in fall 2026.

data.footage_size: about 5,000 square feet, plus a 1,000-square-foot terrace (space being sought)
data.short_description: Shaker is planning a Val-d'Or restaurant and could open at 1830 3e Avenue, where paperwork has reportedly been signed. The project is not officially confirmed, and the Abbatiello group is still searching for a suitable space. The banner has 27 restaurants across Quebec.

data.location: 6862 E Mount Vernon St, Glen St Mary, FL 32040
data.short_description: Burger King is preparing to open in Glen St. Mary, according to the Florida Department of Business & Professional Regulation. Size, drive-thru configuration and opening timeline have not been announced.

data.location: Village at Sandhill (full address not specified)
data.short_description: The Donut Guy is closing its store at the Village at Sandhill, which had been open for about three years. The business is relocating to Winnsboro.

data.status: hoping to be open within the next 30 days
data.short_description: The Donut Guy will reopen in Winnsboro as Donut Guy Express. A representative said it hopes to open within 30 days, but no official date or address has been announced.
Ford's Garage is preparing to open at Beachwalk after St. Johns County issued a permit. It will be the chain's second location in St. Johns County. No opening date has been announced.

data.event_date: Not specified (website says "late fall"; owner says no opening date set)
data.short_description: Burrell & Flynn's Farm is turning the former Old Montmorenci Winery into a restaurant. The website says it is scheduled to open in late fall, but the owner says no date has been set. It will serve lunch and dinner using local and farm produce.
Owner Beth Burrell says she recently opened The Merry Market & Cafe in Windsor.

data.location: 2330 Palm Ridge Rd, Unit 9, Sanibel, FL 33957
data.short_description: Cape Coral ice cream truck Crooked Cow Creamery has submitted plans for a brick-and-mortar in Sanibel. It offers classic flavors as well as THC-, CBD- and alcohol-infused ice creams.

data.location: 1661 Estero Blvd., Suites 11-14, Fort Myers Beach, FL 33931
data.status: opening is being targeted for December
data.short_description: Sol Tequila will open in the former Mr. Tequila space, according to plan review documents. An owner confirmed a December target opening.

data.location: Address not specified (plan review lists Winter Haven home base; Facebook lists Poinciana)
data.short_description: The Idaho-born Jamaican food truck is preparing to operate in Central Florida. Specific locations have not been revealed.
The food truck's Facebook page says it is closed in Idaho and moving to Central Florida.
A new Dunkin' is planned at 405 Serano Way along Laurel Road East, according to plan review documents. Construction is expected to begin in December.

data.location: 3755 S Tamiami Trl, Suite B, Port Charlotte, FL 33952
data.short_description: Priceypoo Bakery LLC submitted plan review documents for a new location across South Tamiami Trail from its current shop at 3880 Tamiami Trail, Suite A. It is unknown whether the move is an expansion or a relocation, and a representative declined to comment.

data.location: 6338 E Santa Ana Canyon Rd, Anaheim, CA 92807
data.short_description: Dollar Tree is preparing to open an Anaheim store, and a plan review has been filed with the Orange County Health Department.
American Fitness Center will open a 24-hour "peak club" in West Roswell, according to its Instagram. Amenities include saunas, a basketball studio, a juice bar and a recovery center.
The Aiken honey and beeswax farm is preparing its first brick-and-mortar store on Laurens St. Shipping is paused while the store is prepared, and an opening date is still to be announced.

data.location: Across the street from 1169 S. Bellevue Boulevard (exact new address not announced)
data.status: getting ready to move into a BIGGER STORE (remodeling underway)
data.short_description: The South Memphis clothing store is relocating to a larger storefront across the street from its current location. Remodeling began, per an October 9 post.

data.location: Countryside Mall, 27001 US Hwy 19, Suite 1003, Clearwater
data.status: The new store will open on November 19
data.short_description: Urban Native, an apparel brand founded by designer Erik Wise in 2014, is moving from Westshore Plaza to Countryside Mall. The store will be near the upcoming Target store.

data.footage_size: 3500-square-foot storefront with a studio attached (Westshore Plaza location)
data.short_description: Urban Native has been at Westshore Plaza since 2020, starting as a kiosk selling face masks. It is now preparing to move to Countryside Mall.

data.status: Next year, it will be adding a new outpost
data.short_description: Lakeside Village in Lakeland will add a new Miniso location, according to a Continental Realty Corporation press release from August. Miniso sells toys, collectibles, beauty, apparel, stationery, home goods and snacks.

Piccolo Buco is close to signing a lease for the former Romano's Macaroni Grill space, but the deal is not final. Pre-submission paperwork was filed with Fairfax County in September, and no opening timeline can be estimated yet.

data.status: will be opening as a part of the upcoming Kayo Center development
data.short_description: The Burgers and Blues team is opening Crafted 81, serving pizza, tacos and smash burgers. It will seat about 110 inside and 150 outside, and is expected to open in March 2027.

data.event_date: Soft opening October 4; grand opening not specified
data.status: soft opening phase, getting ready to hold its grand opening
data.short_description: Little Moose Creamery, a family-run premium ice cream shop owned by Cecile Luk, launched its soft opening on October 4. It is preparing for a grand opening.

data.location: 1305 W. Main St., West Main Commons, Battle Ground
data.event_date: around the first week of January 2027
data.short_description: Brewed Awakenings plans a new coffee shop in West Main Commons with indoor seating along Main Street. Battle Ground is the first of three new Clark County shops, which will bring the company to 10 locations.

data.location: Palisades development near SE Brady Road and SE 192nd Avenue, Camas
data.event_date: probably pretty close to May and June 2027
data.short_description: A Camas shop is planned in the Palisades development, and its street address has not been released. Owner Todd Gunderson said it would follow the Battle Ground opening.

data.location: near Interstate 5 at Exit 16, La Center
data.event_date: probably pretty close to May and June 2027
data.short_description: A La Center shop is planned near I-5 Exit 16, and its street address has not been released. It is one of three new shops in Clark County.

Z Bistro applied on Oct. 21 for a license to serve beer and wine with food at a building that has housed Wing Fa Market. No opening date has been announced, and it is unclear whether the market is closing.

data.status: certificate of occupancy is listed as "in review"
data.short_description: Flaming Pizza filed a certificate of occupancy application for a "limited restaurant" with an occupant load of 20. The owner, Sami Alnajjar, is also associated with a Flaming Pizza in Cordova, and no opening timeline is available.
N/A
Sunrise Memphis will open its third location in a former AutoZone storefront. A commercial alteration permit application is under review.

data.location: 8525 Blue Diamond Rd., Suite 130, Shops at Blue Diamond Durango, Enterprise
data.short_description: The Hawaiian donut shop, with ties to Waikiki, plans its first Las Vegas Valley shop in the Mountain's Edge area. It will feature a glass display kitchen where guests can watch dough being made.
iWingz is planning a new downtown Salem restaurant to replace its 25th Street location, and no opening date has been announced. It has been serving customers from a food truck in the meantime.
The iWingz at 25th Street closed on June 27 after about six and a half years. The business and the property owner could not reach lease terms.

data.location: The Belle Commons, Oxford Commons community, Oxford
data.short_description: Vicksburg's Rusty's Riverfront Grill is expanding to Oxford as "Rusty's Oxford" in The Belle Commons development. Ownership said this is an expansion, not a relocation.

Lakeshore Kitchen, from Jorge Castro's Pearl West Restaurant Group, is coming soon, according to an Instagram post. It will be the second location of the modern American concept, and no opening date has been announced.
Tradesman applied for a Common Victualler License for a ground-floor lobby kiosk. The proposed hours are 7 a.m. to 6 p.m., and the chain currently has six Boston locations.

Happy Belly Food Group said Rosie's Burgers has secured a Mont-Tremblant location, with no address or date disclosed. It will be operated by Carma Hospitality as the fourth of its 10 committed Quebec units.

data.event_date: Construction to start toward the end of next month; wrap up by November 2027; fully open by fall 2027
data.short_description: A permit filed with TDLR shows a $550,000 remodel to meet the new Burger King Sizzle Standards. The work includes upgrades to the dining area and exterior elevation.
Morchella 2.0, a foraging and wild foods restaurant, will run the kitchen at the new bar The Double Down Lounge. Chefs Cameron Dunlap and David Stevenson are behind the food.
Jake and Shela Kagan leased the former 3 Doors Down space to open a neighborhood bar. It will have a DJ booth, a TV showing "Soul Train" and a rotating art gallery.
The original Morchella opened in 2021 in the Sabin neighborhood. It closed at the end of 2024 after about three years.
The owners of the DeutschTroit food truck signed a lease for a German restaurant. The opening date is still being determined because construction needs to begin.
The Chocolate Gallery Cafe at the building closed earlier this month. DeutschTroit's restaurant will take over the space.
Magnolia Bakery will debut its first Philadelphia location in Rittenhouse Square. The franchise owners are John Candela and Jake Klein.

non_working.reason: no business details. It reports only an ownership change at The Rambler, which is staying open, so there is no opening or closing event.
